sentences.text: Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a curious girl named Mia.
Mia loved to learn about the world around her.
One day, she found a book about the human body.
She was excited!
She wanted to know how her body worked.
Mia opened the book.
The first page showed a big picture of the human body.
It had many parts.
There were the head, arms, legs, and feet.
Mia learned that the head holds the brain.
The brain is very important.
It helps us think and learn.
Next, Mia read about the heart.
The heart is a muscle.
It pumps blood all over the body.
Blood carries oxygen and food to every part.
Mia put her hand on her chest.
She could feel her heart beating.
"Thump, thump!" it went.
Mia turned the page.
She saw a picture of the lungs.
The lungs help us breathe.
When we breathe in, we take in air.
When we breathe out, we let air go.
Mia took a deep breath.
She felt her lungs fill with air.
Then, Mia learned about the stomach.
The stomach helps digest food.
When we eat, food goes to the stomach.
The stomach breaks it down.
This helps our body get energy.
Mia thought about her favorite food, pizza.
She loved pizza!
Mia continued reading.
She found out about muscles and bones.
Muscles help us move.
Bones give our body shape.
Mia flexed her arm.
She could feel her muscles working.
She jumped up and down.
Her bones were strong!
Mia was amazed by the skin.
Skin covers our body.
It protects us from the outside.
It keeps us safe.
Mia touched her arm.
She felt her skin.
It was soft and warm.
Finally, Mia learned about the senses.
We have five senses: sight, hearing, taste, touch, and smell.
These senses help us understand the world.
Mia looked around.
She saw the trees and heard the birds.
She smiled.
Mia closed the book.
She felt happy.
She learned so much about her body.
The human body is amazing!
It works every day without us thinking.
Mia decided to tell her friends about what she learned.
They would love to know about the human body too!
